method: the repository's TypeScript encoder re-encoded each source observation and the result was compared against the pool tensors, which were produced by the Python-side conversion pipeline and are consumed by the Python trainer
sideEffect: the exact match also proves the rebuilt GameState is a faithful reconstruction of the archived observation, because a wrong state would produce different tensors
notCompared: action logits and value head outputs across languages (no TS-side forward pass was run)
candidate permutation invariance of the encoder (the encoder is per-candidate and order-free by construction, but this was not separately tested)
verdict: EXACT_MATCH - the TypeScript encoder reproduces the pool tensors bit-for-bit within 1e-6, so the rebuilt candidate features are on the same numeric footing
